v0.4.history: GitHub Actions GF-02 PubMed v0.4 PILOT runs 31834065161 and 31834608428
v0.4.reason: Real PubMed ESearch evidence showed that line #5 used leading unary NOT. PubMed ignored the leading NOT tokens and translated the intended no-abstract/exclusion condition as hasabstract AND excluded publication types. The conceptual condition-neutral rescue is preserved in v0.5, but expressed with valid binary NOT semantics.

#1.label: CORE alimentar/nutricional
#1.query: ("Diet"[Mesh] OR "Nutrition Policy"[Mesh] OR "Nutrition Therapy"[Mesh] OR "Diet Therapy"[Mesh] OR diet*[tiab] OR dietary[tiab] OR nutrition*[tiab] OR "medical nutrition therapy"[tiab] OR "nutrition care"[tiab] OR "dietary care"[tiab] OR "healthy eating"[tiab] OR "dietary pattern*"[tiab])

#2.label: Marcadores normativos — ramo principal
#2.query: (guideline[pt] OR "practice guideline"[pt] OR guideline*[tiab] OR "clinical practice guideline*"[tiab] OR consensus[tiab] OR "consensus statement*"[tiab] OR "position statement*"[tiab] OR "scientific statement*"[tiab] OR "professional statement*"[tiab] OR "expert consensus"[tiab] OR "clinical guidance"[tiab] OR advisory[tiab] OR "standards of care"[tiab] OR "practice standard*"[tiab] OR "professional standard*"[tiab] OR "clinical recommendation*"[tiab] OR "practice recommendation*"[tiab] OR recommendation*[ti])

#4.label: Rescue normativo condição-neutro
#4.query: (guideline[pt] OR "practice guideline"[pt] OR guideline*[ti] OR "clinical practice guideline*"[ti] OR consensus[ti] OR "consensus statement*"[ti] OR "position statement*"[ti] OR "scientific statement*"[ti] OR "professional statement*"[ti] OR "standards of care"[ti])

#5.label: Conjunto positivo de exclusão do rescue
#5.query: (hasabstract OR comment[pt] OR editorial[pt] OR letter[pt] OR "published erratum"[pt])

#6.label: Rescue completo — sem abstract e sem tipos excluídos

pilot_requirements: Preserve the exact submitted expressions, provider-reported totals and NCBI query translation.
Reject or supersede any candidate when PubMed reports a Boolean parser warning that changes intended semantics.
Probe priority sentinels against #3, #6 and #7 without changing the strategy.
Create a deterministic 10-20 record sample from (#6 NOT #3) for human classification; if retrieval is capped, flag the sample as non-representative of the full rescue-only set.
PILOT outputs are never FORMAL or PRISMA-eligible.
